verdict.rationale: Requesty publishes an OpenAPI spec that covers both its inference router and a separate management API, and its changelog tracks management-endpoint parameters, so programmatic control goes beyond inference. However, nothing documents that UI-configured features such as fallback and load-balancing policies, guardrails, MCP server registration, prompt library editing and the analytics dashboard are all reachable through the API, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented management endpoints for policies, guardrails, MCP servers and analytics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: covering both the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible inference router and the management API (servers router.requesty.ai and api-v2.requesty.ai)
